headline: Food pantry plans fall Goodwill drive in King City
summary: KING CITY — The Community Food Pantry of King City will partner with Goodwill Industries for a collection drive Saturday and Sunday, Oct. 24-25, from 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. at the King City High School Broadway parking lot.
source: King City Rustler / South County Newspapers
